CHANGELOG updated in SHANKPIT: S459-57: fixed real spawn-point bug -- custom levels (QUEUE) had no real spawn logic, players scattered up to 1500 units apart on a 325x320-unit level. Now computes real spawn points from the level's own geometry, verified clustering within ~100-280 units live (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
